name: @circuitry/mcp-server
description: MCP server for Claude Code CLI to communicate with Circuitry

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.existsSync('src/tools-snapshot.json')?fs.copyFileSync('src/tools-snapshot.json','dist/tools-snapshot.json'):console.warn('[build] WARN: src/tools-snapshot.json missing — regenerate with the app repo: npm run mcp:generate')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('src/tools-snapshot.json')){console.error('[prepublishOnly] FATAL: src/tools-snapshot.json is missing. Generate it from the app repo: npm run mcp:generate');process.exit(1)}" && npm run build

author: Circuitry
